column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “many” as the subject.
NKJV adds “immediately”; the Greek has “the stones will cry out.”
NKJV includes “especially in this your day” and “your peace,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in this day … the things for peace.”
Close to the Greek; “barricade” is rendered “embankment.”
NKJV includes “and bought … in it,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “those who were selling.”
NKJV has “My house is a house of prayer,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “My house will be a house of prayer.” “Robbers” is rendered “thieves.”
